name: Rabbaanii Islamic School Cikarang
address: Jl. Cimandiri 8B RT.06/08, Graha Asri, Jatireja, Cikarang Timur, Kabupaten Bekasi

notes.id: Biaya gelombang 1 setelah diskon (biaya sebelum diskon ada di sorotan Instagram @rabbaanii_official). Uang pangkal sudah termasuk seragam 5 stel (TK 4 stel), buku paket tahun pertama, SPP Juli 2027, dan uang tahunan. DP minimal 25%, sisa maks. 4 bulan. Uang pangkal tidak dapat dikembalikan bila mengundurkan diri. TKIT: uang pangkal Rp5.300.000 (umum) / Rp5.050.000 (alumni/keluarga RIS); uang tahunan Rp1.800.000.
notes.en: Wave 1 prices after discount (pre-discount prices are in the @rabbaanii_official Instagram highlights). The entry fee includes 5 uniform sets (TK: 4), first-year textbooks, July 2027 tuition and the annual fee. Minimum 25% down payment, the rest within 4 months. Non-refundable if you withdraw. TKIT: entry Rp5,300,000 (general) / Rp5,050,000 (alumni/family); annual fee Rp1,800,000.

period.id: Gelombang 1 mulai 15 September 2026; tes online 16 Oktober dan tes offline 17 Oktober 2026.
period.en: Wave 1 from 15 September 2026; online test 16 October and in-person test 17 October 2026.

steps.id: Daftar online di rabbaanii.sch.id dan bayar formulir.
steps.en: Register online at rabbaanii.sch.id and pay the form fee.

steps.id: Ikuti tes online dan offline sesuai jadwal gelombang.
steps.en: Take the online and in-person tests on the wave's dates.

steps.id: Daftar ulang: bayar DP uang pangkal minimal 25%.
steps.en: Re-register by paying at least 25% of the entry fee.

notes.id: Untuk pindahan dan pengajuan subsidi/beasiswa hubungi CS 0853-1364-2033.
notes.en: For transfers and subsidy/scholarship requests contact CS 0853-1364-2033.
